outcome: Home based postpartum care by healthcare providers
cohort: 7590 women who had live births two years preceding the 2016 Ethiopian Demographic and Health Survey
finding: Home based postpartum care by healthcare providers was low (6.3%), and factors associated with receiving this care included perception of distance to healthcare facility, wealth index, antenatal care attendance, place of birth, mode of delivery, and awareness of neonatal danger signs.
mod_finding: Women who gave birth by caesarean section were more likely to receive home based postpartum care by healthcare providers [AOR = 3.41; 95% CI: 2.33, 4.99].
